summary: All 6 acceptance-matrix criteria verified across 6 browser checks + 3 backend test files (one criterion, nutrition simulation, gets both lanes; roti conversion gets both lanes too). All checks passed.

checks.criterion: Non-veg ingredient section is visible on desktop without horizontal scrolling
checks.name: nonveg-chip-visible-desktop
checks.evidence: At 1440x900 viewport, category-non-veg-filter-button and category-all-filter-button both visible with bounding box within viewport width; clicking Non-veg revealed chicken, mutton, rohu-fish, prawns, egg, crab, squid ingredient cards.

checks.criterion: Recipe shelf is compact by default
checks.name: recipe-shelf-compact-default
checks.evidence: recipe-results contained exactly 4 [data-testid^=recipe-card-] elements on initial load with All filter; recipe-see-more-button visible.

checks.criterion: See more and Show less work
checks.name: recipe-see-more-show-less
checks.evidence: Clicking See more expanded card count from 4 to 35 (matches backend catalog total) and button text changed to Show less; clicking again collapsed back to 4 and label reverted to See more.

checks.name: recipe-filter-resets-expansion
checks.evidence: After expanding to 35 cards, switching to Breakfast, Main Dish, Vegetarian, and Non-Vegetarian filters each collapsed the shelf to <=4 cards with See more button reappearing.

checks.criterion: Medium roti ingredients are count based
checks.name: roti-piece-count-conversion
checks.evidence: Added Medium Roti and Medium Jonna Roti from Grains category; both pot rows defaulted unit select to pieces_count; simulating 1 piece each produced raw-weight-value = 100 g (40g + 60g).

checks.criterion: Medium roti ingredients are count based (piece-weight API contract)
checks.name: test_tscheck_roti_piece_weights.py
checks.evidence: GET /catalog/ingredients: medium-roti default_unit=pieces_count piece_weight_g=40, medium-jonna-roti default_unit=pieces_count piece_weight_g=60. POST /catalog/calculate with 3x medium-roti pieces -> raw_weight_g=120.0 (approx 40g*3); 2x medium-jonna-roti pieces -> raw_weight_g=120.0 (approx 60g*2). Status 200 both.

checks.name: nutrition-simulation-completes
checks.evidence: Added Medium Roti, incremented servings, clicked Simulate my pot; nutrition-total-calories and per-serving-calories-value populated with non-zero numeric values. No requestfailed events, no response>=400, and no browser console errors captured during the flow.

checks.name: test_tscheck_nutrition_simulation.py
checks.evidence: POST /catalog/calculate with medium-roti x2 pieces, servings=2 -> 200 OK; totals and per_serving objects contain all 9 nutrient keys (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sodium, iron, calcium, b12); per_serving.calories ≈ totals.calories / 2 within 1% tolerance.
